title: NBA2 v3 requirements register
source_note: Decomposed from the project brief plus the engineering requirements v3 needs to satisfy it. Each row names a file that can be read and a check that can be run, because a status a reviewer cannot verify is a claim, not a measurement. Statuses reflect this session (arena/a1fddb57-nba2); blocked rows name the missing input rather than a missing implementation.

status_key.met: the artefact exists, runs, and a named check exercises it
status_key.partial: built and running, but a required input or measurement is missing
status_key.blocked: cannot be completed until a data source exists; the code path is written
status_key.not started: identified as required, deliberately not attempted

requirements.requirement: Split the site into a projection surface and a gated bet surface and never mix them.
requirements.acceptance: Each page declares exactly one surface; the build fails if a page renders as a surface other than the one it was scheduled under; a projection page contains no stake field.
requirements.evidence: nba2/v3/build.py SURFACES + build_pages() surface assertion; nba2/v3/check.py check_structure() rule 4

requirements.requirement: Two independent estimators, with their disagreement published as the primary confidence signal and any blend underneath.
requirements.acceptance: Estimator A (running point differential) and B (constrained least-squares strength) computed from the same games; disagreement on every line; the blend labelled fallback and never shown as a headline.
requirements.evidence: nba2/v3/backtest.py _ratings_diff/_ratings_lsq; nba2/v3/model.py two_estimators; lines page 'Disagree' column

requirements.requirement: Pin home-court advantage to the measured home-win rate; do not fit it freely.
requirements.acceptance: h = sigma * Phi^-1(measured home rate), and Phi(h/sigma) returns that rate exactly. The unconstrained fit is reported, its implied home rate shown, and it is not the published number.

requirements.requirement: Total = possessions x points-per-possession, not an average of team scoring averages.
requirements.acceptance: Possession total computed per game from official POSS and per-game scoring; the average-of-averages printed beside it on every row; the measured error of both published.
requirements.note: The formula is implemented and correct. Its forecast is worse than a constant on MAE (16.05 vs 15.13), which is published as a finding rather than hidden. Improving it needs per-game possession distributions the repository does not hold.

requirements.requirement: Price every parlay with a measured rho and print the naive product beside it.
requirements.acceptance: Bivariate-normal copula price with the naive product on every leg; rho measured with n and a Fisher-z interval; a rho measured against a constant is rejected as not a measurement.

requirements.requirement: Report luck as a z-score per club and refuse to publish a strategy leaning on a club outside the noise band.
requirements.acceptance: Luck z per club with a band label; a refusal gate that blocks a pick touching a club outside |z|>1.96; the share of picks refused stated.
requirements.evidence: nba2/v3/model.py calibrate() luck block; nba2/v3/strategies.py luck_gate
requirements.note: 0 of 30 clubs are outside the band today, so the gate refuses nothing. Stated as such rather than presented as a clean bill of health.

requirements.requirement: Freeze a pre-registration file per strategy before its first bet: signal, thresholds, universe, exact settlement rule.
requirements.acceptance: One hashed JSON per rule containing all four fields; the hash bound into every pick the rule produced; a rule edited after the fact fails verification.

requirements.requirement: Tamper-evident ledger: hash each published pick, publish the hash before tip, verify after settlement.
requirements.acceptance: Per-pick canonical-JSON hash with the rule's prereg hash bound in; a chained root; editing a result, editing a hash, deleting a pick and reordering all break verification.

requirements.requirement: Blend the model line with the closing line, weighted by measured out-of-sample log-loss.
requirements.acceptance: w_model = L_market/(L_model+L_market) with both log-losses measured out of sample.
requirements.note: No odds feed is connected, so L_market does not exist. The model's own out-of-sample log-loss is measured (0.7082 raw, 0.6398 calibrated) and the formula is published with two inputs explicitly labelled as illustrations.

requirements.requirement: Store every injury PDF with a timestamp and diff consecutive reports for status changes.
requirements.acceptance: Archive of every revision with its revision time and its retrieval time; a diff producing added/dropped/status-change/date-move counts; a banner showing both timestamps and the lag.
requirements.note: The banner and the diff work. Only 2 of the 29 listed revisions were fetched, so the within-day diff is NOT MEASURED and the cross-release diff compares different slates (0 shared players). Both limits are stated on the page.

requirements.requirement: Compute rest, back-to-back and 3-in-4 from the official schedule, and travel distance from a sourced arena-coordinate table.
requirements.acceptance: Rest/B2B/3-in-4 per club per game; great-circle travel from a 30-row arena table; the home club's travel defined as 0 and the away club's as distance from the previous venue.
requirements.note: Implemented and spot-checked (NYK->BKN 7.7 km, BOS->LAL 4171.7 km). Multi-game road-trip accumulation is not carried and the page says so. Three of eight checked clubs had no prior road venue, so travel is legitimately 0 or blank.

requirements.requirement: Model minutes redistribution explicitly: top-8 minutes shares plus replacement shares when a player is out.
requirements.acceptance: A per-club top-8 share table and a replacement share, driven by per-player game logs.
requirements.note: Per-player game logs are not in the repository. No redistribution is estimated from season averages, because a season average is the quantity an absence changes. Every affected line carries FLAG-V3-ROTATION-UNFILED.

requirements.requirement: Originate own NBA lines for every upcoming slate up to 3 days ahead.
requirements.acceptance: One line per game in the window with both estimators, disagreement, total, conditions and availability.
requirements.check: python3 -m nba2.v3.check (semantic: p_home == Phi(m/sigma) per row)

requirements.requirement: Research and develop signal strategies with validation gates, remove luck, and be selective about skill.
requirements.acceptance: Six pre-registered rules scored against their own base rates; a multiplicity correction; a ranking bar; a gate report with pass/fail/not-measurable per gate.
requirements.note: Six rules run and none is ranked (largest settled count 97 < the 100-bet bar). After Holm correction across the family, one rule clears its base rate and four do not; the winner is published with three reasons it is still not a recommendation.

requirements.requirement: Settle the sealed ledger from official finals when each game day ends, keeping the settlement stamp visible.
requirements.acceptance: Settlement only from a verified final whose quarter scores sum to the printed total; open picks excluded from every rate.
requirements.evidence: nba2/v3/strategies.py settlement_rule per pick; nba2/v3/official.py FINALS
requirements.note: All five 2026-11-14 finals are captured with quarter scores that sum. No pick has yet reached a settled state in this build, so the settlement path is written and its rule is sealed per pick but has no settled rows to show.

requirements.requirement: Prove the walk-forward cannot see its own targets.
requirements.acceptance: Same-date isolation, no in-sample term, and a future-only edit, all passing, plus the rejected naive test documented.

requirements.requirement: Publish results that contradict the model's own headline.
requirements.acceptance: Raw log-loss worse than a coin, margin error worse than a tie, and the possession total worse than a constant all appear on the pages beside the numbers that beat their baselines.
requirements.evidence: site/v3-calibration.html, site/v3-backtest.html, site/v3-totals.html; 14 flags on site/v3-flagged.html
requirements.check: python3 -m nba2.v3.check (semantic: every flag must appear on the flagged page)

requirements.requirement: Every number on the site traces to an official page, and every blank carries a reason.
requirements.acceptance: Every data row carries a source URL; no empty cell; the v2 whole-site checker passes on the v3 pages too.
requirements.check: python3 -m nba2.v2.check (226 -> 0 problems after the v3 source columns were added)
